pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is the highest of the notes d, r and m? (1 mark)
   A. d
   B. m
   C. They are all the same
   D. r

2. The recorder notes G, A and B match the sol-fa syllables (1 mark)
   A. r, m and d
   B. d, r and m
   C. m, d and r
   D. m, r and d

3. A lighter tone of a colour is called a (1 mark)
   A. outline
   B. shade
   C. primary
   D. tint

4. Why should you not dive into shallow water? (1 mark)
   A. You can hit the bottom and hurt your head or neck
   B. It looks silly
   C. It makes noise
   D. It makes splashes

5. In a good sprinting technique, the elbows are bent to about (1 mark)
   A. a straight line
   B. a full circle
   C. a right angle
   D. a tiny angle

6. Listening for the name of a note without seeing it is called (1 mark)
   A. running
   B. painting
   C. aural work
   D. drawing

7. Which position takes the centre pass to start the game? (1 mark)
   A. C, Centre
   B. GD
   C. GS
   D. GK

8. The word photography comes from words meaning (1 mark)
   A. drawing with paint
   B. drawing with light
   C. drawing with sound
   D. writing with ink

9. If the skin of a drum is loose, the sound is (1 mark)
   A. higher
   B. the same as a tight skin
   C. lower
   D. louder than a tight skin always

10. Verse 3 of the anthem talks about (1 mark)
   A. sports
   B. working together to build the nation and giving thanks
   C. the weather
   D. cooking

11. In a glide, your face is (1 mark)
   A. hidden by a hat
   B. high above the water
   C. in the water with the head between your arms
   D. turned to the side always

12. Why delete poor photographs? (1 mark)
   A. To make the screen dark
   B. To cool it
   C. So memory is not filled up
   D. To break the camera

13. Which folk songs welcome a new baby? (1 mark)
   A. Naming songs
   B. Work songs
   C. Initiation songs
   D. Funeral songs

14. The song Hot Cross Buns can be played on (1 mark)
   A. B A G
   B. only G and C
   C. only drums
   D. C D E only

15. If someone is drowning, the safest action for a child is to (1 mark)
   A. jump in to save them
   B. shout for an adult and throw something that floats
   C. run away silently
   D. laugh

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Why is it important to appreciate the percussion instruments of different communities? (3 marks)

17. Why is gymnastics not a race? (2 marks)

18. Explain how working in pairs helps when learning the crab balance. (3 marks)

19. How should clay models be dried and why? (2 marks)

20. State what red, white and the shield stand for on the Kenyan flag. (3 marks)

21. Write what the signs p and f mean. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — m
   Me is the highest of the three.

2. B — d, r and m
   If G is doh, then A is ray and B is me.

3. D — tint
   Adding white makes a tint.

4. A — You can hit the bottom and hurt your head or neck
   Shallow water is dangerous for diving.

5. C — a right angle
   Bent arms swinging back and forth help the stride.

6. C — aural work
   Aural work uses the ears to identify notes.

7. A — C, Centre
   The Centre takes the centre pass.

8. B — drawing with light
   Photography means drawing with light.

9. C — lower
   A loose skin vibrates more slowly, so the sound is lower.

10. B — working together to build the nation and giving thanks
   It calls for common effort and gratitude.

11. C — in the water with the head between your arms
   Keeping the face in helps the body stay level.

12. C — So memory is not filled up
   Deleting saves space.

13. A — Naming songs
   Naming songs are sung when a baby is named.

14. A — B A G
   It uses the three notes B, A and G.

15. B — shout for an adult and throw something that floats
   Do not enter the water; get help and throw a floating object.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: They show the culture and skill of each community. They help us respect one another. They should be preserved for future generations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is about control and quality of movement, not about speed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for control, 1 mark for not speed.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: One learner performs while the other watches and checks, gives feedback, and helps if needed. They swap places.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Slowly in the shade. Strong sun dries them too fast and makes them crack.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Red stands for the blood shed for freedom. White stands for peace and honesty. The shield and spears stand for the defence of freedom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: p means soft. f means loud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
